file_name: Global Infrastructure Management and EQT led consortium - AES Corporation - Questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Global Infrastructure Management (including its connected entities, such as BlackRock, Akaysha, Recurrent or Vena Energy), EQT (including any of their interests such as OX2) or QIA (including any of their interests such as Nebras Power) are close competitors with AES Corporation and there are not many alternatives, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.

Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Global Infrastructure Management, EQT, QIA and/or AES Corporation (including any of their interests or connected entities).
